prompt-clarification-disambiguation.title: Improving, clarifying and disambiguating a prompt for an agent
prompt-clarification-disambiguation.description: Skills for turning a vague, ambiguous or weak prompt for an agent into a clear, precise, executable brief — clarifying, disambiguating, eliciting, rewriting, interrogating, evaluating and optimizing.

system1-reviewers-classifiers.title: System 1 models for fast reviewers and classifiers
system1-reviewers-classifiers.description: Skills for operating small, fast, cheap models (Haiku-class, GPT-mini-class, Gemini Flash-class, small open models) as reviewers and classifiers — prompting and structured outputs, review and classification harnesses, evaluation and calibration, routing and escalation, scale, and guardrails.

threejs-visualizer.title: ThreeJS interactive visualizer — a net of stars in space
threejs-visualizer.description: Skills for building a ThreeJS interactive visualizer: a net of stars in space, shifting and moving around. Aesthetic: glory, misty.
